notes.title: New Codebreaker Update
notes.content:
Trivia Vault Science & History has a new update.  Here is a list below of the new additions and changes.  As always, if you encounter any issues post below.

Changes:

New codebreaker lifelines have been added, these can be each be used once per vault.  They will remove 1 wrong answer, 2 wrong answers, or instantly answer 1 question correctly.

After answering a question, the wrong and right answers will be highlighted red/green accordingly so you can learn as you go.

Questions have been reorganized for a better flow.

Questions and answers have been reevaluated for typos various mix ups.


Previous and new Trivia Vault updates are in the works, stay tuned for additional info.
